results.title: Arriba Tutto
results.overview: A seven-year-old boy's magical childhood with his street performer father ends tragically. Years later, he struggles with anger and bitterness, having lost the joy and wonder he once knew.

results.title: Bad Counselors
results.overview: After committing a crime on campus, two frat-stars pretend to be Christian camp counselors in order to fulfill court ordered community service.

results.title: Ave Mujica - prima aurora -
results.original_title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora
results.overview: More than half a year has passed since Ave Mujica's comeback, and spring has arrived. The band's popularity continues to grow, while each member's individual activities are also gaining momentum. The next venue Sakiko proposes is a members-only masquerade ball. What lies behind the intentions of the girl who swore to become a god...?

results.title: Korean Kanakaraju
results.overview: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

results.title: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
results.overview: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

results.title: Oh Butterfly!
results.overview: When a series of unfortunate coincidences involving a woman, her husband and her ex, culminates in a shocking death, her long-lost sister returns to redeem her.

results.title: The Birthday Party
results.overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

results.title: Find Your Friends
results.overview: A sinister spin on twenty-something party culture, revealing the darkness beneath the carefree facade. What starts as a wild girls trip turns dangerous when hostile locals escalate tensions and Amber's past trauma surfaces. As the group fractures under toxic dynamics, their fun getaway transforms into a revenge-fueled nightmare.

results.title: Beyond Top Secret: The Era of Disclosure
results.original_title: Beyond Top Secret: The Era of Disclosure
results.overview: Dr. Steven Greer leads the charge toward ultimate disclosure. Bringing forward firsthand military whistle-blowers, the film exposes the decades-long institutional cover-up surrounding off-world technology and classified programs.

results.title: Letters from the Silenced Country
results.overview: A hybrid documentary portraying contemporary Belarus through the individuals who have endured imprisonment, repression, and exile — voices from a silenced country, suffocated by the regime.

results.title: L'irréparable - 1995, le discours du Vel d'Hiv
results.original_title: L'irréparable - 1995, le discours du Vel d'Hiv

results.title: Das Geheimnis der gestohlenen Maske
results.overview: Does the mask of the Makonde really have magic powers and can it settle the terrible quarrel between Johanna and her best friend? Johanna desperately needs the mask, but before her eyes it is stolen from Leipzig's Grassi Museum and Grandpa Kito is considered the prime suspect! Kito has just appeared from Tanzania and wants the mask, brutally stolen in colonial times, to return to his village. For Johanna, there is more at stake than unmasking the real thief - she must find her own identity.

results.title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in São Paulo
results.original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in São Paulo
results.overview: The Latin American leg of BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ reaches the big screen through a delayed presentation of the São Paulo concert. It brings the scale and excitement of BTS’s stadium performance into the cinema, offering fans a communal live-viewing experience shaped by the energy of a packed Brazilian venue.

results.title: Spatial
results.overview: A sound-forward story that follows Henri Beckett, a reclusive, audio field recordist who captures a chilling occurrence during one of her ambient sessions.

results.title: A Mass for Dom Angélico
results.overview: Dom Angélico was born into a poor family and distinguished himself by supporting the social movements that emerged in the late 1950s. He was the bishop of the oppressed and of the protest marches, a champion of the struggle for better housing and living conditions for workers. He led crowds at masses dedicated to human rights. In the realm of journalism, he kept communities informed through *Grita Povo*. Persecuted by the military dictatorship, he confronted the police and faced repeated arrests and threats, yet he never fell silent. Dom Angélico lived for 92 years, believing it possible to unite faith in God with political action for a better world.

results.title: Whistleblower
results.overview: A great-nephew of Lumumba exposes corruption in the Congo. US drone pilot reveals that innocent people are systematically being killed in attacks. Marc Bauder profiles people who expose widespread injustices—accompanied by Panama Papers authors Frederik Obermaier and Bastian Obermayer, as well as whistleblower advocate Delphine Halgand-Mishra. S.B.

results.title: Little Nightmares - Broken Promises
results.overview: Locked in an attic, a neglected little girl escapes into a miniature world full of promise, until she discovers its terrible secrets: behind every shadow lurks a monster.

results.title: Starlight
results.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

results.title: The Phantom
results.overview: Two female producers are commissioned to create a short documentary for an exhibition dedicated to Rubén Santantonín, an elusive figure of the Argentine avant-garde who died very young, in the late 1960s. However, the client imposes one unexpected condition: the video must be made together with David Lamelas, Santantonín’s former collaborator and today an internationally recognized figure of conceptual art. At first, the plan seems clear and limited in scope: Lamelas, accompanied by a young film crew, gathers archival materials, documents the few surviving works, and interviews curators and major artists – such as Luis Felipe Noé and Marta Minujín – who, along with Santantonín and Lamelas, peopled the legendary scene at the Instituto Torcuato Di Tella. Lamelas gradually realizes that reconstructing the story of his friend also means confronting a series of gaps and contradictions.

results.title: Kamen Rider Eins with Girls Remix
results.original_title: 仮面ライダーアインズ withガールズリミックス
results.overview: All the incidents occuring around the Girls Remix up to this point were part of Sumire Kurono's plan to create the ultimate Kamen Rider. Now that plan is moving into its final phase. Sumire kidnapes Nayuta Mikazuki again. After performing her final surgery, "Kamen Rider Eins" is finally born. Will the Girls Remix be able to get Nayuta back? And what will become of Nayuta, who has become Kamen Rider Eins?
